articles.title: Microsoft to start disclosing Azure quarterly revenue as company consolidates business units
articles.description: Microsoft will begin reporting quarterly Azure revenue in dollars for the first time, providing more clarity about its business that competes with AWS.

articles.title: Broadcom delivers strong earnings view as CEO touts growth with AI labs
articles.description: Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter but provided robust earnings guidance for fiscal 2028.

articles.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
articles.description: The NBA also fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and said the team will forfeit five first-round picks, one in each year in drafts starting in 2029.

articles.title: Trump and Xi are set to meet in DC. Why some China watchers have low expectations
articles.description: Trump's summit with Xi is expected to take place less than six weeks before the U.S. election, with polls showing Democrats favored to make gains in Congress.

articles.title: Japan’s Remixpoint Dumps Ethereum, XRP in Shift to Bitcoin-Only Treasury
articles.description: The Japanese company booked a ¥117.8 million profit after selling its ETH, SOL, XRP and DOGE, leaving roughly 1,506 BTC as its only cryptocurrency holding.

articles.title: US officials work with CrowdStrike to fight malware behind crypto theft
articles.description: Federal authorities and private-sector partners were part of an operation to disrupt malware that redirected about $150,000 in crypto over the last eight years.

articles.title: DOJ says Hamas crypto seizures reached $560,000 as FBI took over fundraising sites
articles.description: FBI agents took control of domains and servers, specifically Alqassam.ps, to intercept donations and prevent further fundraising for the Al-Qassam Brigades.

articles.title: Travel industry presses Trump to target 100 million international visitors in Oval Office meeting
articles.description: Trump’s meeting with travel executives comes after a World Cup that showcased his unusually close relationship with FIFA President Gianni Infantino.

articles.title: New Jersey asks the Supreme Court to take on prediction markets
articles.description: The petition comes after a key ruling from the 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals on sports-event contracts.

articles.title: Trump floats renaming Strait of Hormuz the 'Trump Strait'
articles.description: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright told CNBC that more than 17 million barrels of oil transited the strait on Monday, a wartime record.

articles.title: Coinbase launches regulated crypto derivatives in Canada
articles.description: Coinbase is offering eligible Canadian traders perpetual and dated futures with up to 10x leverage as major US trading platforms expand their crypto presence in Canada.

articles.title: J&J's run to record highs hasn't reached the finish line yet. Here are the key drivers
articles.description: Jim Cramer agrees with UBS: The rally in Johnson & Johnson shares still has room to run.

articles.title: USTR's Greer huddles with House Republicans amid Trump trade spats
articles.description: Trump's plan to lower tariffs on 300,000 metric tons of imported beef caused an uproar among cattle ranchers.

articles.title: Top Pentagon AI Official Sold Millions in Perplexity Stock, Disclosures Show
articles.description: Emil Michael's latest financial filings show a summer exit from Perplexity, months after a January sale of xAI stock that reportedly netted him up to $24 million.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.description: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

articles.title: 10-year U.S. Treasury yield hits highest level since November 2023
articles.description: The 10-year Treasury note yield reached a fresh multiyear high on Wednesday as inflation and debt concerns pressured global government borrowing costs.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs, BofA Among 21 Banks Planning Joint Dollar Stablecoin Launch
articles.description: The bank-led consortium wants a U.S. dollar token live by the first half of 2027, with a euro version queued up next.

articles.title: Uber to cut 10% of workforce in bid to move 'simpler and faster'
articles.description: Uber is cutting small teams by nearly half and allowing about 1% of its workforce to continue working remotely.

'The Right Trade': Strategy CEO Has No Regrets Selling Bitcoin at $60K Before Buying Back Higher
articles.description: Phong Le said Strategy’s cost of capital—not Bitcoin’s price—drove its decision to sell nearly 7,000 BTC before resuming purchases above $80,000.
